title: Creole Serenaders at 15 and her own band at the Othello Theater
summary: At about 15 she joins the Creole Serenaders with Peter Bocage, then leads a four-piece Othello Theater band on Rampart Street with T-Boy Dominic, Joe Welsh and Kid Faso.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: And then, when I was, oh, about 15, I started with the Creole Serenaders.
Oh, was that with Peter Bocas? Bocas.
I played a long time with them. Oh, yeah. And then, I had my own band for a while playing at the Othello Theater on Rampart Street. Oh. How far up?
Where was that? I don't remember.
That was in the third block.
Third block? Of Rampart. Oh, uptown. Uptown.
Yeah. They had a theater there, the Othello Theater. Yes, I don't know. That's before my time. And I had my own band there.
Was that for movies, or did they have vaudeville and shows?
They had vaudeville and pictures at the time.
How big a band did they use about?
Well, they used only four pieces. Four pieces. Yeah. And those four pieces was T-Boy Dominic on a trumpet. I think he's still living.
I think he's in California. He used to be in the Eureka Band when I first came here.
Then there's Joe Welsh on the violin. Well, he is dead.
And the drummer, we only know him by Kid Faso.
Oh, yes. I have pictures of him yet.
You have? Well, that was the drummer in that band and myself. Well, that was my band.
I was just about 16 then. 16. And then after I quit with Menev, that is after he retired from playing. He retired to teach.
